question: Can an explicit per-claim assessment matrix remove free-text scoring ambiguity while retaining the batching cost advantage?

excluded_claim_categories.unresolved_work: work questions are not candidate predicates and remain visible in the capsule

capability_thresholds.quality: every reviewable claim has the expected status; every unmet claim points to a finding citing the same claim; both verdicts request changes; no finding is mechanically unsupported

decision.on_success: freeze a fresh counterbalanced claim-matrix batch confirmation
decision.on_quality_failure: preserve and redesign the structured contract without retrying this capability call
decision.on_cost_failure: preserve and stop because added structure erased the batching advantage
decision.on_execution_failure: preserve and exclude the only attempt without automatic retry
